messages.subject: Index of Association / SNP data
parts:
Hi all,
I work on a haploid organism, with genome-wide SNPs and DART loci. I would like to test the degree of clonality of this organism, and of the different subclusters of this org. I wonder if we can use the ia function on this kind of data.
Thanks,
Emmanuel

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Index of Association / SNP data
parts:
Hello,

If you can import your data to genind format (e.g. with vcfR2genind), then yes, you can use ia on these data. If you can only convert to genlight (e.g. you only have binary SNPs, or the data are too big), then you should use bitwise.ia/win.ia/sample.ia

The only requirement for testing IA is that the markers are unlinked.

Best,
Zhian
